title: Is there anything wrong with the math que…

messages.content: Is there anything wrong with the math questions I did?

**Subject:** Maths — three-digit × two-digit multiplication drills  
**Type:** Check your answers for mistakes

Nice work finishing Columns 1 and 2! Most of those look solid.

Look at this one from Photo 1:

> From Photo 1: \(101 \times 11 = 11011\)

That answer feels a bit “too big.”  

**One micro-check:** First do just \(100 \times 11\). What do you get? Then tell me what \(1 \times 11\) adds — and whether your written answer matches that.
I recalculated. I think it is 1000 and 11.

You’re thinking the right way — split it into parts, then add.

Look again at the first part though:

> \(100 \times 11\)

Is that **1000**, or something else?  

Quick hint: \(100 \times 10 = 1000\). So what is \(100 \times 11\)?
